abstract: Dermoid cysts are typically known to occur in the midline, near the lines of embryonic fusion, from trapped ectodermal tissue. They are very rare in the gastrointestinal tract, and only a few cases of dermoid cyst in the caecum and ileum have been reported in the literature. In our case, a dermoid cyst was found in the transverse colon, which has not been reported previously.
abstract_ja: 類皮嚢腫は典型的には正中部、胚発生の癒合線の近傍に生じ、迷入した外胚葉組織に由来する。消化管での発生は非常にまれであり、盲腸および回腸の症例が数例報告されているにすぎない。今回我々は、横行結腸に生じた類皮嚢腫を経験した。これは、これまでに報告のない部位である。
